artifact_observations.reasoning: The traffic lights fail to maintain rigid geometric structure. They appear melted or deformed, lacking the hard edges and distinct components (lenses, visors) required for this object class.
Car bodies exhibit slight smearing and lack of sharp panel lines. Road markings (crosswalks) have soft, bleeding edges rather than crisp paint application.
Overhead wires curve unnaturally and seem to disconnect from poles. Building windows in the background show slight warping and inconsistent alignment.
